test_title: PYST 05: SSC Stenographer - English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 11 Dec 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in direct speech.

She told her friend that she had been studying for her examination.

options.text: She told her friend, “I had studied for my examination.”
She tells her friend, “I have been studying for my examination.”
She told her friend, “I am studying for my examination.”
She told her friend, “I was studying for my examination.”

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Indirect Speech:** She told her friend that she had been studying for her examination.
